objective: Avoid scans and ownership bookkeeping for unrelated semantic method and callable records by selecting exact-name candidates in stable order.

baseline.measurement_origin: target/ast-lowering-0.1.13/full-candidate.json; preceding iteration, same session and frozen workspace

limitations: One matched diagnostic pair. The full-build baseline is the preceding SSA-scope iteration measurement in the same session; the new candidate uses the same exact frozen workspace path, source digests, dependency sources, native toolchain, dev profile and eight jobs. This is not a statistical performance or CI guarantee.

Each cold build starts with an empty target and private compiled-artifact cache; dependency sources and OS page cache are retained. No compiler builds, tests or external profiler overlap either full timed build or the measured diagnostic pair.

The diagnostic binary-workspace loader selects 256 Graphene modules and 4201 bodies, while the native metadata workspace has 258 modules and 4211 bodies. Its publication phase encodes and hashes replay payloads without artifact-cache disk writes.

Name indices are immutable and module-local, share across that module's checked functions, and retain all overloads in source view order. Generic-bound overlays get their own complete method index. There are no persistent cache-format or runtime C changes.
Native tests run on Linux x86_64 with Clang 23.1.3; two fresh extreme bootstrap stages use Ubuntu 24.04 / Clang 18 Docker. Other native OS CI platforms have not run.
